commitments.detail: The policy will be enforced starting August 25 with a rate limit of 100 requests per minute for both ordinary API keys and authentication endpoints.
Implementing a rate limit of 100 requests per minute for ordinary API keys and authentication endpoints without a staffed launch window.
The policy will enforce 100 requests per minute for ordinary API keys and authentication endpoints, effective August 25, 2023.
